svg.title: Research questions, two bodies of work, and findings
svg.desc: Three panels: two research questions, two bodies of work (the design corpus of AI interface designs, and prior studies of theory and findings), and findings on workflows, cognitive work, and support designs. RQ1 asks: What knowledge and skills matter as AI changes work? RQ2 asks: How do scaffold designs support work and learning? Frozen card-production snapshot dated 2026-09-28: Design corpus, 4,695 mechanism-card records and 1,933 theory-lineage cards for AI-involved papers; Prior studies, 512 retained sources containing 2,867 claims. The required end state pairs one mechanism card and one theory-lineage card per retained AI-involved paper, and claims with a theory-lineage card per retained prior-study source. The snapshot does not establish completed paired-card cohorts.
